def grid_with_cuts(h,w,rc,cc,marks):
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in rc: g[r]=[8]*w
    for c in cc:
        for r in range(h): g[r][c]=8
    for r,c,v in marks:g[r][c]=v
    return g
def fill_cells(g, rc, cc, cell_colors):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); rbd=[-1]+list(rc)+[h]; cbd=[-1]+list(cc)+[w]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i,(ra,rz) in enumerate(zip(rbd,rbd[1:])):
        for j,(ca,cz) in enumerate(zip(cbd,cbd[1:])):
            v=cell_colors.get((i,j),0)
            for r in range(ra+1,rz):
                for c in range(ca+1,cz):
                    if v: out[r][c]=v
    return out
